name: Tampermonkey
summary: A popular userscript manager that allows running custom user scripts on web pages.
issueSummary: Tampermonkey has updated to support Manifest V3. Users may search for guidance when scripts stop working or when migrating between browsers.
shortAnswer: Tampermonkey is actively maintained with MV3 support in modern Chrome. If a specific script stops working, it may be incompatible with the current browser or Tampermonkey version.
whatHappened: Tampermonkey has been updated to support Manifest V3 in Chrome.
Some older userscripts may be incompatible with newer Tampermonkey versions.
Scripts from unmaintained sources may stop working without notice.
Browser permission changes can affect script behavior.
migrationSteps: Update Tampermonkey to the latest version from the Chrome Web Store.
Check for script updates in the Tampermonkey dashboard.
If a script is broken, search for an updated version or alternative script.
Verify the script source before reinstalling.
Test scripts in incognito mode to check for conflicts.
Consider Violentmonkey as an alternative if Tampermonkey continues to have issues.
safetyNotes: Only install scripts from sources you trust.
Userscripts can access all page content and make network requests.
Review the script code before installing if the source allows it.
Avoid scripts that request excessive permissions beyond their stated purpose.

alternatives.name: Violentmonkey
alternatives.bestFor: Users seeking an open-source MV3-compatible userscript manager
alternatives.note: Violentmonkey is a practical MV3-compatible alternative with open-source transparency.

alternatives.name: Greasemonkey
alternatives.bestFor: Firefox users wanting the original userscript manager
alternatives.note: Greasemonkey is best known for Firefox.

faqs.question: Is Tampermonkey safe to use?
faqs.answer: Tampermonkey itself is a well-established and reputable script manager. Safety depends on the scripts you install. Only install scripts from sources you trust, and review their permissions.

faqs.question: Why did my userscript stop working?
faqs.answer: Scripts may stop working due to website changes, Tampermonkey updates, browser updates, or script incompatibility. Check for script updates or search for alternative scripts.

faqs.question: Can I use Tampermonkey on Firefox?
faqs.answer: Yes, Tampermonkey is available for Firefox as well. Your scripts may be compatible across browsers.

faqs.question: What is the best alternative to Tampermonkey?
faqs.answer: Violentmonkey is a practical open-source alternative with good MV3 support. For Firefox users, Greasemonkey remains well-established.
